The measurements were taken on real showcase kernels through `bootStack`, under `single` with the Default Organization and under `isolated` (posture-only):

| path | `single` | `isolated` |
|---|---|---|
| REST / session write | stamped | stamped |
| seed loader (inline, pinned, sole-organization fallback) | stamped | stamped |
| elevated system write (`isSystem`, no `tenantId`) | **NULL, not refused** | **NULL, not refused** (an application-object control in the same boot is refused `walled-posture`; the same insert carrying `tenantId` lands stamped) |

- **Fixture to re-measure when the early return is lifted.** `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-bu-hierarchy-sharing.dogfood.test.ts:66` calls `findOne('sys_organization', { where: {} })`. Once C8 lifts the early return, the fixture's bare `isSystem` membership inserts (`:73`–`:74`) meet a two-organization `single` install, so they would be refused `ambiguous-organization` rather than derived.
